notes: The session's web search allowance ran out after the first candidates, so most local candidates were looked up only on their government's own site; blanks mean not looked for further, not that nothing exists. Party pages that list or 'support' candidates without saying endorsed (already in ballot/lean/ne_endorsements.json) were not recorded as endorsements. sherry4nekids.com (linked by the Nebraska Examiner for Sherry Jones) answered 503 and was left out. Verifier: the four judges' pages now live on nebraskajudicial.gov (the old addresses redirect there) and the urls were changed to match; the Nebraska Examiner voter guide was not re-opened, so the website notes now rest only on what each site itself says; Sherry Jones's page says only 'Elected to State Board of Education - 2022', so 'from' was cut to that; the Omaha Public Schools page names Ms. Almanza Zavala as a board member but not her subdistrict; Rick Beard's site names his running mate as Ruby Barnes where our list has Keenya Barnes; Rick Holdcroft's quote is from the title of a site whose content dates from his 2021 announcement.
